date: Nov 13, 2026 · Week 1 / Day 5 · Visibility & early risk communication

cards.title: Lead with the release exposure
cards.question: PCIe Gen5 margin is 0.4 dB and layout freeze is Monday. What is your 20-second headline?
cards.selfCheck: State the release decision at risk, measured margin, confidence, and deadline. Exercise: give the headline before mentioning any simulation activity.
cards.prompt: Coach a 20-second risk-first update for PCIe Gen5 0.4 dB margin before Monday layout freeze. Grade impact, confidence, decision ask and brevity.

cards.title: Don't turn correlation into proof
cards.question: EM predicts 53 Ω while TDR reads 55 Ω. Can you sign off the connector?
cards.selfCheck: Separate observation from cause; identify calibration, launch and model uncertainty. Exercise: name one discriminating test and a signoff checkpoint.
cards.prompt: Role-play a design review: EM predicts 53 ohms and TDR measures 55 ohms. Challenge my uncertainty language, test plan and signoff recommendation.

cards.title: One risk, three owners
cards.question: A 19 MHz PDN peak needs VRM, package and board input. Who drives closure?
cards.selfCheck: Assign one integrator and explicit deliverables for each team. Exercise: request load-spectrum, impedance and transient evidence with a shared deadline.
cards.prompt: Help me build a concise cross-functional PDN risk closure plan for a 19 MHz peak, including VRM, package and board owners.

cards.title: Offer a bounded choice
cards.question: A 3 dB crosstalk miss needs spacing changes that threaten freeze. What do you propose?
cards.selfCheck: Present two feasible mitigation paths, their margin/schedule costs and a decision deadline. Exercise: make a non-blaming ask to layout.
cards.prompt: Role-play a layout freeze tradeoff meeting with a 3 dB crosstalk budget miss. Coach two options, decision criteria and influence without authority.

cards.title: Five risks, one decision memo
cards.question: How do you brief a director on PCIe, TDR, PDN and crosstalk in 60 seconds?
cards.selfCheck: Rank by release impact; give confidence, owner, next proof and escalation trigger for the top risk. Exercise: finish with one specific decision request.
cards.prompt: Conduct a Week 1 Principal Engineer oral review. Give me four SI/PI risks; ask for a 60-second prioritized executive update, score risk framing, uncertainty, ownership, deadline and decision request.
